subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Vocabulary: long, longer, longest; short, shorter, shortest

show.line: Three ribbons. The red one is long. The blue one is longer. The green one is the longest of all!

rounds.praise: Yes! That pencil is the longest.
Yes! That snake is the shortest.

rounds.prompt: Look at the two ropes. Is the yellow rope longer or shorter than the brown rope?
Measure the book with paper clips. How many clips long is it?
Put the sticks in order. Short, longer, then what comes next?
Which is longer, your foot or your hand span? Tap your answer.
rounds.praise: Yes! A foot is longer than a hand span.

hints: Line the ends up. Then look at which one sticks out more.
Longest means longer than all the others.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the longest ribbon.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The red ribbon is the longest!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The green ribbon is the longest. Red is the shortest.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's line them up together. The green one sticks out the most. Longest!

parent_line: Can compare and order lengths using longer, shorter, longest and shortest.
